mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an imminent monetary easing cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over the past month, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals weakening labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal a contraction in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader demand weakness and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST decline for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A supply-side shock (INDPRO < 100 for two consecutive months) combined with labor market stress (UNRATE rising) indicates dual economic disruption that reduces corporate profitability and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 100 for 2 consecutive months AND UNRATE rising
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100 for two months and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in the consumer price index above 3.5% signals persistent inflation that triggers delayed monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls above 200,000 per month signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds 200,000, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below its 12-month moving average for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS below 12-month moving average for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS is below its 12-month moving average for two months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 100 for three consecutive months signals manufacturing sector contraction that reduces corporate output and profits, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO is below 100 for three consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year period.
